# openwrt_system (Resource)

Core system settings (`config system`).

Manages a `system` section in `/etc/config/system`. This section normally exists on a stock router: creating the resource adopts it (renaming an anonymous section to `section`), and destroying the resource only removes it from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `conloglevel` (Number) Console log level. (UCI option `conloglevel`.)
- `cronloglevel` (Number) Cron log level. (UCI option `cronloglevel`.)
- `description` (String) Short description shown in LuCI. (UCI option `description`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname. (UCI option `hostname`.)
- `klogconloglevel` (Number) Kernel console log level. (UCI option `klogconloglevel`.)
- `log_buffer_size` (Number) Kernel log buffer size in KiB. (UCI option `log_buffer_size`.)
- `log_file` (String) Persistent log file. (UCI option `log_file`.)
- `log_ip` (String) Remote syslog server. (UCI option `log_ip`.)
- `log_port` (Number) Remote syslog port. (UCI option `log_port`.)
- `log_proto` (String) Remote syslog protocol. (UCI option `log_proto`.) One of: `udp`, `tcp`.
- `log_remote` (Boolean) Enable remote logging. (UCI option `log_remote`.)
- `log_size` (Number) Size of the in-memory log in KiB. (UCI option `log_size`.)
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes. (UCI option `notes`.)
- `timezone` (String) POSIX TZ string, e.g. `CET-1CEST,M3.5.0,M10.5.0/3`. (UCI option `timezone`.)
- `ttylogin` (Boolean) Require login on the serial console. (UCI option `ttylogin`.)
- `urandom_seed` (Boolean) Save a random seed across reboots. (UCI option `urandom_seed`.)
- `zonename` (String) Olson zone name, e.g. `Europe/London`. (UCI option `zonename`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
